dataset.name: WTC 1 V8P floor-specific vertical state graph
dataset.scope: Digitize the floor-specific axial-force contours in NIST Figures 4-60 and 4-61 for all 47 core columns over Floors 93-99, reconstruct impact-induced vertical state increments, and test a graph interpolator on Columns 705, 804, and 605 kept out of model selection.
dataset.warning: The contour images and DCR maps are outputs of the same NIST global model. This iteration tests internal cross-output predictivity and identifiability only; it is not an independent structural solution or evidence for any collapse mechanism.

sources.fact: Figures 4-60 and 4-61 display axial-force contours along every WTC 1 core-column line before and immediately after impact. Compression is negative in the figures and each six-series panel has its own ten-level legend.
sources.confidence: high; complete pages visually checked and PDF image/color resources inspected

sources.fact: Table 4-20 reports total WTC 1 core-column loads at each Floor 93-99 before and immediately after impact.

digitization.missing_segment_interpretation: If no colored element crosses the sampled floor marker after an expanded local search, the axial-force interval is recorded as zero and separately flagged as an absent displayed segment.

vertical_state_graph.state_definition: delta_P(column,floor) = after-impact axial compression minus before-impact axial compression.
vertical_state_graph.innovation_definition: u(column,99)=delta_P(column,99); u(column,f)=delta_P(column,f)-delta_P(column,f+1). Reconstructing delta_P downward by cumulative summation enforces vertical state continuity exactly.
vertical_state_graph.predictor: Kernel regression of innovation residuals around the official per-floor mean innovation. Damaged columns remain known boundary references; reserved columns are never used during parameter selection.
vertical_state_graph.inner_validation: Leave one non-damaged, non-reserved column out at a time; all seven after-impact floor intervals for that column are untouched during its prediction.
vertical_state_graph.selection_score: Lexicographic minimum of mean distance outside the observed intervals, midpoint MAE, then maximum midpoint error.

acceptance_gates.physical_interpretation: Passing would validate only a bounded interpolation of selected NIST cold outputs. It would not identify the actual floor membrane, connection law, or real-event collapse mechanism.

summary.gate_explanation: Au moins un controle reserve ou de numerisation echoue; aucune etape thermique ou Blender n'est autorisee.
summary.gate_decision: **NON VALIDE.** Le graphe vertical ne satisfait pas tous les seuils reserves ou les controles de numerisation.
summary.report_conclusion: V8P ajoute les donnees nodales verticales absentes des iterations precedentes, mais le chemin froid reste non valide sur les criteres declares.
summary.interpretation: Bounded cross-output NIST emulator only; not an independent structural solution, event probability, or demolition test.
